title: Funk, Sabu & Douglas cross the line
summary: Terry Funk’s veteran credibility, Sabu’s dangerous unpredictability and Shane Douglas’s ambition collide. Their championship struggle helps establish ECW’s new identity before the formal break with the NWA.

chapters.title: Funk takes the championship from Sabu
chapters.result: Funk defeats Sabu for the ECW Heavyweight title.
chapters.context: The veteran becomes the target for two very different challengers.

chapters.title: The hour-long three-way draw
chapters.show: The Night the Line Was Crossed
chapters.result: Funk, Sabu and Douglas reach the 60-minute time limit.
chapters.context: Funk retains, but the unresolved three-way battle gives all three a continuing claim to the spotlight.
